name: TerzoConto – Rendiconto ETS
author: Gabriele Prandini

sections.description:
TerzoConto is a WordPress plugin designed to help Italian Third Sector Organizations (ETS) manage accounting and financial data.

The plugin supports structured data import (CSV), validation, and administrative workflows, simplifying compliance and bookkeeping.

Main features:

  • CSV data import
  • Data validation
  • Administrative interface
  • Modular architecture (services and repositories)
  • Extensible structure for future integrations

Project Status

Terzo Conto is actively developed and already usable in production environments, although some planned features are still under development and documentation is currently limited.

Planned future features include:

  • generation of the donation communication file for the Italian Revenue Agency (Agenzia delle Entrate);
  • support for the new simplified financial statement model (“Modello E”) intended for Italian Third Sector Organizations (ETS) with annual revenues below €60,000;
  • expanded documentation and user guides.

Feedback, bug reports, suggestions, and contributions are welcome.

For support, collaboration, or contribution inquiries, you can contact:
gabriele.prandini@gmail.com

Please note that support is provided on a best-effort basis.

License

This plugin is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later.

Credits

Developed by mjfan80.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Access the plugin section in the admin panel
sections.faq:
Which file formats are supported?

Currently CSV files are supported.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

The plugin follows WordPress best practices, but compatibility is not guaranteed.

Are data validated?

Yes, imported data are validated according to predefined rules.
